title: Towards Fair In-Context Learning with Tabular Foundation Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating group fairness metrics (Demographic Parity, Equalized Odds, and Equal Opportunity) on tabular foundation model predictions using datasets such as the ACS PUMS tasks and CelebA, where gender is defined as the sensitive attribute.

Evaluating group fairness metrics (Demographic Parity, Equalized Odds, and Equal Opportunity) on tabular foundation model predictions using the Diabetes dataset, where race is defined as the sensitive attribute.

Evaluating group fairness metrics (Demographic Parity, Equalized Odds, and Equal Opportunity) on tabular foundation model predictions using the German Credit dataset, where age (over or below 25 years old) is defined as the sensitive attribute.
